UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private player profile and lifetime Mensch game statistics.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

displayName.description: Player display nickname shown on the board.

GameRoom.title: GameRoom
GameRoom.description: A 4-player online classic Persian Mensch game room with real-time board state.

roomCode.description: Unique 6-character uppercase code matching the room document ID.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room creator.

publicLobby.description: Whether the room is discoverable in the public waiting lobby.

lobbyKey.description: Single-field index key derived from status and publicLobby for secure lobby listing.

memberUids.description: List of 1 to 4 authenticated human player UIDs currently in the room.

seatUids.description: Fixed 4-element list mapping seat 0..3 to player UID, BOT_1..3, or empty string.

seatNames.description: Fixed 4-element list of seat player display names.

seatBotFlags.description: Fixed 4-element boolean list indicating whether each seat is controlled by a bot.

tokens.description: Fixed 16-element integer array representing progress (-1..43) of 4 pawns per seat.

currentTurnSeat.description: Index (0..3) of the seat whose turn it currently is.

diceValue.description: Current die face (0 if not rolled yet, 1..6 after roll).

consecutiveSixes.description: Count of consecutive sixes rolled in the current turn (0..3).

winnerSeat.description: Winning seat index (0..3), or -1 while match is ongoing.

lastEventText.description: Localized Persian description of the most recent game event.

voiceEnabled.description: Whether in-game voice chat is enabled for this room.

updatedAt.description: Last state update timestamp (submitted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

VoicePacket.title: VoicePacket
VoicePacket.description: Compressed G.711 mu-law voice audio packet broadcast inside an active Mensch room.

senderUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the speaker.

senderSeat.description: Board seat index (0..3) of the speaker.

memberUids.description: Denormalized list of room member UIDs authorized to listen to this voice packet.

/users/{userId}.description: Private per-user profile and game statistics.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: 4-player online classic Mensch rooms and synchronized board state.

/rooms/{roomId}/voice_packets/{packetId}.description: Real-time voice chat packets scoped to members of the parent room.
